title: Playing an operation
intro:
Clicking for a credit is slow. Operations are the Corp's one-shot cards: pay the cost, resolve the text, and the card goes to Archives. Hedge Fund costs 5 and pays 9 — a net gain of 4 for a single click.

This lesson: play Hedge Fund, then finish your turn.
outro: Hedge Fund is the best money in the deck, and the Runner's Sure Gamble is its mirror. Watch the play cost: you must have the 5 credits before you get the 9. Next: servers, and what installing a card into one means.

steps.prose: You have 5 credits and 3 clicks. Hedge Fund costs 5: play it and take 9.
Nine credits. Spend your two remaining clicks however you like, then end your turn — with 5 cards in HQ there is nothing to discard.
